youtube.title: Why Is The Ocean Salty? 🌊 #Shorts
youtube.description:
Rivers aren't salty. So why is the ocean?

Rain is very slightly acidic. Over time it slowly dissolves rocks. Rivers carry those tiny dissolved minerals to the sea. The sun evaporates the water, but the salt stays behind. Hot vents on the sea floor add even more. If you took all the salt out and spread it on land, it would be about a hundred and fifty metres deep.

Watch our full episodes on the channel.
